rules.name: Decorative graphics hidden from assistive tech
Labels or instructions — placeholder is not a label
Name, role, value — hidden but focusable

unchecked.name: Contrast (minimum, non-text)
unchecked.why: Artifacts are styled with CSS variables the consuming project supplies. Whether a block passes depends on a palette we do not control.

unchecked.name: Meaningful sequence
unchecked.why: Needs rendered reading order, not source order.

unchecked.name: Reflow
unchecked.why: Needs a viewport at 320 CSS pixels.

unchecked.name: Label in name
unchecked.why: Needs the rendered visible label to compare against the accessible name.

unchecked.name: Consistent navigation and identification
unchecked.why: A property of the whole consuming site, not of one artifact.

unchecked.name: Focus not obscured (minimum)
unchecked.why: New in WCAG 2.2. Whether a sticky header covers the focused element depends on the rendered page an artifact lands in, not on the artifact.

unchecked.name: Consistent help
unchecked.why: New in WCAG 2.2. Asks whether help is in the same place across a set of pages, which is a property of the consuming site.

unchecked.name: Redundant entry
unchecked.why: New in WCAG 2.2. Needs to know whether two fields in a multi-step flow ask for the same information, which is a question about meaning rather than markup.

unchecked.name: Focus appearance
unchecked.why: New in WCAG 2.2, and Level AAA — outside the AA target, listed so a reader can see it was considered rather than missed.
